messages:
Taylor (People Ops): FYI - delivery mismatch at 11:10. A box labeled 'internal promo' was dropped for 'Ops Team' but the manifest says 'Design'. Can someone check if this is ours?

Riley (Front Desk): Got it. It's on the cart by the door labeled PKG-902. No name on the slip besides 'Ops Team'. I can hold it but lobby is getting busy.

Morgan: That sounds like the banner stands we ordered last week. I asked Design to route them to marketing but maybe vendor used old label. @Riley can you open and confirm contents?

Riley (Front Desk): Opening now. One banner tube, 2 small boxes with promo stickers, and a stack of brochures. Photo uploaded: img_1835123468.jpg.

Taylor (People Ops): If it's promo material, keep it separate from personal packages. Please put fragile stickers on the small boxes and move them to locker D1.

Chris (Facilities): I can move the bulky tube to the storage closet so it doesn't block the lobby. Also will put a 'do not drop' sign on the coffee table.

DeliveryBot: PKG-902 scanned at 11:10. Note: "left with front desk per receiver".

Morgan: Confirmed these are the banner stands. Sorry for the vendor mix-up  I'll pick them up at 11:45 and bring them to Studio B.

Riley (Front Desk): Quick heads-up: we only have one hotdesk near meeting room free at that time. If someone needs it, let me know and I'll reserve.

Taylor (People Ops): Morgan, can you take the hotdesk for the 11:45 pickup? I'll tag the box in D1 as 'Morgan - do not redistribute'.

Morgan: Yes please reserve it. Also can Facilities leave a dolly near door 1? The tube is heavy.

Chris (Facilities): Dolly parked by door 1. Moved tube to storage bench A and labeled it 'PKG-902 - Morgan pick up'.

Riley (Front Desk): Checked guests: two couriers came by looking for a "J. Patel" delivery earlier but left. If that turns up later I'll triage.

Taylor (People Ops): Thanks team  smooth handling. Quick note: let's remind vendors to include recipient names on manifest to avoid lobby pileups. I'll shoot a template email.

Morgan: Thanks everyone  saved our meeting schedule. :tada:
